name: zcode-breaker
description: Tool circuit breaker + session burn guard for ZCode: blocks the same (tool + input) repeated over the limit within a window, warns on repeated prompts, and warns when the session's model-io grows past burn tiers. Same rule as unified-rx-mcp tools/breaker.py.

description_i18n.en: Tool circuit breaker + session burn guard for ZCode: blocks repeated (tool + input) over the limit, warns on repeated prompts and on session token burn tiers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 工具熔断 + 会话烧量哨兵：同一（工具+参数）窗口内重复超阈值即阻断；重复指令告警；会话 model-io 越档（15/30/50/80MB）注入收尾建议。与 unified-rx-mcp 的 tools/breaker.py 同规则（宿主级 + 工具级双保险）。
